descriptionChirho: The proper noun designating Sennacherib, king of Assyria (705-681 BCE), who invaded Judah during the reign of Hezekiah (2 Kgs 18:13-19:37; 2 Chr 32:1-22; Isa 36:1-37:38). All 13 occurrences refer to the same historical king. The two clusters represent minor transliteration variation in some target languages (eng 'Sancheriv' vs 'Sennacherib', spa 'Senaquerib' vs 'Sanjeriw') but the core referent is identical across all translations: arb 'سَنْحَارِيبُ', kor '산헤립', swa 'Senakeribu', hin 'सन्खेरीब / सन्हेरीब'. No semantic split is warranted.
